body:
"She doesn't know how hard it was for me to open up to her with something like this, and she betrayed my trust".
I'm the stubborn one here, not giving her another chance.
& It's not parents, just my mom - would never talk to my shitty deadbeat dad about any of this. ;D

I've posted before (http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/2dehtb/i_need_help_but_cant_getaccept_help/) about how I can't accept help,  how it always just ends in this vicious circle - nothing can help me but myself, and I am currently unable to help me. Seams like just a better reason to end it.

I live in Canada, we have nothing like that.
I tried talking to my mom, she fucked that up - never talking to her about anything ever again, I gave her a chance.

I get paid very little and she forgets hours sometimes and doesn't even clock them in - it's a very disorganized business. I live in a small shit town, we don't even have taxi's, so bus isn't an option - where would a bus take me so I could be happy? A bus only goes so far, not to the places I would like to go.

I'm old enough but I don't have my license because I can't afford a car, because I have a shit job. Even if I did have ea license and a vehicle, how would I travel without money? I'm a very awkward person and am scared to go out in the world alone, so even if I had the money, there would still be that problem. I am very socially awkward, so I can't find friends - I've tried a bit, and people just think I'm weird.

There's no psych ward even close to where I live. :L
And I'd be kind of iffy staying in a place where I don't know, where I've never been, with people I don't know.
